basic_details.offering_entity: Utrecht University & Utrecht Excellence Scholarship Fund
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Utrecht University Utrecht Science Park Campus (Utrecht, Netherlands)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Master's programmes in Faculty of Science: Computing Science, Applied Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Business Informatics, Game and Media Technology, and Mathematical Sciences.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~20 to 25 highly selective full and partial scholarships awarded annually across all master's programmes
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global competition; typically 1 to 3 outstanding Pakistani scholars selected annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years (standard duration of Master's programme; 120 ECTS credits), subject to satisfactory progress in Year 1

nationality_requirements: Non-EU/EEA international students who are required to pay non-EU tuition fees
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or closely related STEM field from an HEC-recognized university with highest academic distinction (top 10% of graduating class; minimum 82% aggregate or CGPA 3.60 / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Utrecht University requires an official statement of class ranking from the university registrar confirming applicant is in top 10% of cohort.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial background in algorithms, discrete mathematics, programming, operating systems, and computer architecture.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in their final undergraduate year can apply conditionally; degree completion certificate required before August.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; technical research projects and academic publications significantly strengthen the application.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic min 6.5 (writing 6.0+) or TOEFL iBT min 93 (components 24+). Medium of Instruction letters not accepted for degrees from Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: UES is awarded either as tuition fee waiver + EUR 11,000 living allowance (fully funded) or tuition fee waiver only.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be combined with another Dutch government scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition waiver covering non-EU graduate tuition (~EUR 21,500 / year value; ~PKR 6,665,000 / year).

admission_application_fee.details: Utrecht University non-refundable application fee of EUR 100 paid online via OSIRIS portal.

accommodation.details: Utrecht University Reserved Accommodation Programme through SSH Short Stay assists international students with student dormitories; rooms average EUR 450 to 700/month.

monthly_stipend.details: Full UES recipients receive an annual living allowance of EUR 11,000 / year (~EUR 916 / month; ~PKR 284,000 / month). Tuition-only recipients cover living costs through family savings or NL Scholarship supplements.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Amsterdam Schiphol Airport (AMS) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Dutch residence permit (VVR) and entry visa (MVV) fee of EUR 228 paid to IND via Utrecht University visa office.

health_insurance.details: International student health insurance (e.g. Aon Student Insurance, ~EUR 55/month; ~EUR 660/year) required for residence in the Netherlands.

food_allowance.details: Food and living subsistence covered comfortably by the EUR 11,000/year living allowance.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Utrecht University Library resources, digital journals, compute servers, and Department of Information and Computing Sciences facilities.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental travel grants available for Master's thesis students presenting papers at academic conferences.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to EUR 1,000 per conference presentation

travel_transit_allowance.details: U-OV tram/bus transit fares paid by student; bicycle transit is universal across Utrecht.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single leading Dutch research university: Utrecht University (Utrecht, Netherlands)
participating_institutions: Department of Information and Computing Sciences (Utrecht Science Park)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 100 global university (ARWU Shanghai #52, THE World #66, QS World #107); Netherlands' top-ranked comprehensive university with prominent computing and data science departments.
available_majors: MSc in Computing Science: Algorithmic Foundations
MSc in Computing Science: Software Technology
MSc in Game and Media Technology
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS in CS/STEM with 3.6+ GPA, official top 10% class ranking statement, motivation letter, CV, 2 recommendation letters, and IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 93+.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Artificial Intelligence and Applied Data Science are intensely competitive; Computing Science (Software Technology), Business Informatics, and Game and Media Technology offer slightly more favorable admission ratios.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: A formal class ranking letter from your university registrar confirming that you rank in the top 10% of your graduating class is strictly mandatory for UES consideration.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Studielink & Utrecht University OSIRIS Online Application
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on Studielink.nl for your target Master's programme, then log into the Utrecht OSIRIS portal, complete your application, and apply for the UES.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (October - January): Register on Studielink.nl and submit study enrolment for Utrecht University.
Step 2 (In OSIRIS portal): Complete application profile and upload degree certificates, transcripts, CV, and motivation letter.
Step 3 (Class ranking proof): Upload an official document from your university confirming you belong to the top 10% of your graduating class.
Step 4 (Scholarship section): In OSIRIS, indicate that you wish to apply for the Utrecht Excellence Scholarship.
Step 5 (By 31 January): Pay EUR 100 application fee and submit before the strict UES deadline.
Step 6 (February - March): Faculty scholarship committee evaluates and ranks candidate files.
Step 7 (Mid-April): Admission decision and UES scholarship results announced via OSIRIS.
Step 8 (April - May): Accept offer, arrange housing via SSH, and submit documents for Dutch MVV visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated application: UES application is submitted directly through the OSIRIS portal as part of the master's admissions workflow.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two academic recommendation letters uploaded directly in OSIRIS or submitted via automated referee invitation.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Program motivation letter plus statement answering: (1) Academic achievements and evidence of belonging to top 10%, (2) Intellectual vision, (3) Why Utrecht University is the ideal institution.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: 1 to 2 page academic CV detailing education, technical competencies, programming skills, capstone projects, and academic honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; decisions are based purely on academic evaluation of submitted application materials.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (93+). GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified scans uploaded with application; official degree certificates verified upon arrival.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via Studielink and Utrecht OSIRIS portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned color copy of original Bachelor's degree certificate and official English translation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit 4-year BS degree certificate; HEC attestation recommended.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete consolidated semester transcripts detailing all completed course units, grades, and grading scale.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure transcript clearly states credit hours and grading scale (CGPA out of 4.0).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official letter or certificate signed and stamped by university registrar confirming applicant ranks within top 10% of graduating cohort.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Mandatory requirement; obtain formal class rank / percentile certificate from NUST, FAST, LUMS, GIKI, or UET registrar.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1-2 page essay articulating academic background, technical interests, and motivation for target master's track.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight final-year project (FYP) and technical tools used.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 to 2 page CV detailing academic background, programming proficiencies, capstone projects, and distinctions.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly link GitHub repositories, hackathons, and published work.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Two academic reference letters from university professors assessing analytical and intellectual capacity.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees must submit from institutional email addresses (.edu.pk).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS Academic TRF (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT score report (93+).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be valid through application deadline; MOI letters strictly not accepted.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: 31 January 2026 (Strict UES deadline for September intake)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Strict 31 January deadline for September intake. No scholarship consideration for late applicants.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 65% (Academic excellence, CGPA, grades in mathematics and core computing coursework, verified top 10% class standing)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Quality of motivation letter and alignment with curriculum)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Faculty of Science UES Selection Committee and Department of Information and Computing Sciences Academic Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Point-based merit ranking: Committee ranks all applicants who provide verified proof of top 10% ranking. Dossiers are scored on academic excellence, academic quality of home university, and motivation. Scholarships awarded strictly in order of merit ranking.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: 2,200+ non-EU international applicants across Utrecht University Master's programmes
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~1% to 2% among qualified Pakistani STEM applicants
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate degree in CS/SE from premier university (FAST, NUST, LUMS, GIKI, UET), official top 5% ranking letter, exceptional algorithm and mathematics grades, IELTS 7.5+.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, and GIKI.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, India, United States, Pakistan, Turkey, Brazil, South Africa

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized recruiters advertising guaranteed admission or scholarships at Utrecht University. Applications must be submitted directly via Studielink and OSIRIS.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Utrecht application fee is EUR 100 paid online via OSIRIS. Never pay fees to external agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Utrecht University does not collaborate with recruitment agents. Plagiarized statements result in immediate rejection.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Flight ticket from Pakistan to Amsterdam: ~PKR 250,000 to 380,000.
First month's rent deposit in Utrecht: ~EUR 1,200 (~PKR 372,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: You do not need official proof of class ranking. (FACT: Official proof from the registrar that you rank in the top 10% of your class is strictly mandatory for UES eligibility).
CLAIM: All UES scholarships cover living costs. (FACT: Some UES awards cover tuition only; only top recipients receive the full tuition + EUR 11,000 allowance package).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some commercial blogs state that the deadline is 1 April. For non-EU scholarship applicants, the deadline is ALWAYS 31 January.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance and complete at least 60 ECTS credits during Year 1 to renew the scholarship for Year 2.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical enrollment at Utrecht University.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews conducted by the Faculty of Science.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Dutch student visa permits part-time work of up to 16 hours per week (work permit required from employer) or full-time during summer months.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates qualify for the Dutch 1-year Orientation Year visa (Zoekjaar) to seek employment or launch a startup.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: No clawback of previously awarded funds; academic failure results in cancellation of scholarship for Year 2.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship is granted for the nominal 2-year duration (120 ECTS) and cannot be extended.
